violation_type.title: Document maintained is original for completion in personnel record or copy is available of needed (26 TAC §744.1331(c)(2))
violation_type.short_title: Document maintained is original for completion in personnel record or copy is available of needed
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation did not have a copy of one employee CPR/first certificate upon Licensing's request.

finding_variants.text: The operation did not have a copy of one employee CPR/first certificate upon Licensing's request.
One of three employee files reviewed did not include a copy of the employee's CPR/First Aid training verification.

The Site Director CPR/First-aid certification was not available for review while observing staff files. The most recent certification was an online course obtained online. The CPR/First-aid certification observed for the staff was dated, July 6, 2020.
At the time of inspection, three camp counselors did not have a copy of their CPR/First Aid certification cards on file in their records for review.
The operation did not have documentation of a CPR card that showed the caregiver completed the class in person.
